description.value: T&T Supermarket is a regional grocery chain with multiple locations across British Columbia. This North Vancouver branch on King George Boulevard offers full supermarket services including fresh produce, prepared foods, and general groceries. A convenient stop for touring cyclists needing to resupply.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM identifies this as a legitimate T&T Supermarket location with opening hours and payment methods documented.
